stem.text: Which compound would produce a carboxylic acid and a ketone when treated with hot, concentrated acidified manganate(VII) ions?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of an unbranched alkene with the C=C bond at one end of the chain.

B.alt: Skeletal formula of an unbranched alkene with the C=C bond in the middle of the chain.

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched alkene with a side branch on each carbon of the C=C bond, one branch pointing up and one down.

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched alkene with side branches drawn on the C=C bond.
